description: Source code implementing the DwarfCUToModule class and related DWARF debugging information processing, including handling of DIEs, source lines, and module functions within the Google Breakpad project.

classes.name: DwarfCUToModule
classes.description: Main class for processing DWARF compilation units and converting them into module data.

classes.name: Specification
classes.description: Holds information about a DWARF DIE specification, including qualified and unqualified names.

classes.name: AbstractOrigin
classes.description: Represents the base definition of an inline function in DWARF.

classes.name: FilePrivate
classes.description: Contains private data for a DWARF file, such as string sets and DIE specifications.

classes.name: FileContext
classes.description: Context for processing a specific DWARF file, including section mappings and module association.

classes.name: CUContext
classes.description: Holds shared data for a DWARF compilation unit during processing.

classes.name: DIEContext
classes.description: Tracks context information for a specific DIE during processing.

classes.name: GenericDIEHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class for handling DWARF DIEs.

classes.name: FuncHandler
classes.description: Handles DWARF subprogram DIEs, extracting function info.

classes.name: NamedScopeHandler
classes.description: Handles DWARF namespace, class, and structure DIEs.

classes.name: WarningReporter
classes.description: Reports warnings and errors encountered during DWARF processing.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeUnsigned
methods.description: Handles unsigned attribute processing in DIEs.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeReference
methods.description: Handles reference attribute processing in DIEs.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeString
methods.description: Handles string attribute processing in DIEs, including demangling.

methods.name: ComputeQualifiedName
methods.description: Computes the fully qualified name of a DIE.

methods.name: EndAttributes
methods.description: Finalizes attribute processing for a DIE.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Completes processing of a compilation unit, assigning source lines and functions.

methods.name: StartCompilationUnit
methods.description: Begins processing a compilation unit, checking DWARF version.

methods.name: StartRootDIE
methods.description: Determines if a DIE is a valid root DIE for processing.
